title: Referral flow
description: Example assembly for the referral flow: referral-invite → referral-share → referral-reward. It owns the navigation state the three screens refuse to hold — which step is on the route, the friends invited so far (from the invite form or the share screen) and the errors the last invite form rejected — and counts the reward numbers from that one list. It moves between the screens the way a client router does: the screens draw plain hrefs (hrefFor), the assembly intercepts the clicks it owns and leaves modified clicks and every other link to the browser, and the invite form is a submission read off its emails field. Rewrite it against your own router and API; the screens under it stay presentational.
